lessons.trigger_condition: validated peer-learning summaries can exist alongside V378 autonomy but conflicting, malformed, or single-system evidence is not itself a pre-mutation decision gate
lessons.prevention_rule: V379 must consume only strict summary-only peer-learning envelopes, block mutation before V378 on malformed or conflicting exchange evidence, re-read exchange inputs before mutation and hold if they changed during decision, require independent local reproduction for single-system evidence, allow corroborated summaries only as bounded advisory council signals, and never auto-apply peer fixes or promote peer content into facts, trust, prices, grades, market direction, model weights, source code, or Git writes
validation_required: tablet runtime manifest includes v379 while preserving v378 v377 and v376
malformed information exchange fails closed before V378 mutation
conflicting peer fixes fail closed before V378 mutation
exchange input digest is rechecked before mutation and change during decision fails closed
single-system peer evidence requires independent local reproduction and cannot influence local behavior directly
corroborated peer summaries may enter only the advisory information-exchange neural council
peer content is never used for direct model training and peer fixes are never auto-applied
peer exchange never shares raw state or auto-promotes facts trust prices grades or market direction
V378 100+1000 quality governance remains the mandatory quality gate
V377 single-run lock and V376 evidence barrier execution journal verified learning and ambiguous-retry protections remain preserved
runtime self-extension remains allowlisted declarative capabilities only
source-level new functions remain non-executable proposals requiring protected branch PR CI and full regression
physical Tablet runtime and Drive readback remain unverified until matching external evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V379 adds autonomous information-exchange judgment and conflict governance around V378; it does not directly train from peer content, copy peer fixes, create arbitrary source code or commands, write Git/main, weaken verification, invent facts/prices/grades/market direction, or claim physical-device success without evidence
